description: This PHP class implements an interface to a Trello issue tracker, providing methods for connecting to Trello via API, retrieving issue details, normalizing issue IDs, and building URLs for issues. It manages configuration settings, handles connection status, and exposes specific functions to interact with Trello issues programmatically.

classes.name: trellorestInterface
classes.description: A PHP class that interfaces with Trello's REST API to manage issues within a Trello board, supporting connection setup, issue retrieval, URL construction, and ID validation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the interface, sets configurations, and attempts connection to Trello.

methods.name: completeCfg
methods.description: Completes and validates configuration settings, preparing options for API interaction.

methods.name: getAPIClient
methods.description: Returns the current API client instance used for Trello interactions.

methods.name: normalizeBugID
methods.description: Extracts a concise bug ID from various Trello URL formats or ID strings.

methods.name: checkBugIDSyntax
methods.description: Validates the syntax of a given Trello issue ID.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to Trello using API credentials, sets the connection status.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Returns whether the connection to Trello is active.

methods.name: buildViewBugURL
methods.description: Constructs and returns the URL to view a specific Trello issue.

methods.name: getIssueStatusCode
methods.description: Retrieves the status code of a Trello issue.

methods.name: getIssueStatusVerbose
methods.description: Returns a human-readable status string for a Trello issue.

methods.name: getIssueSummaryHTMLString
methods.description: Fetches the HTML formatted summary of a Trello issue.

methods.name: checkBugIDExistence
methods.description: Checks if a Trello issue exists based on its ID.

methods.name: getIssue
methods.description: Fetches details of a specific Trello issue, returning key info for display or processing.

methods.name: getCfgTemplate
methods.description: Provides a template XML snippet with necessary configuration parameters for Trello API setup.
